description: PAID ($0.0045 USDC via x402). Scan text you are about to read — a fetched web page, an email, a tool description, another agent's message — for the shapes that hijack agents: instruction-override phrasing, a redefined system role or persona, requests to move credentials or keys, hidden directive tags and invisible Unicode. Returns a verdict (malicious / suspicious / no_known_pattern) and every pattern found with its severity. The same ruleset scans every FiatDock marketplace listing. Pattern-based: no_known_pattern is not a guarantee. Up to 8,000 characters per call; nothing is stored. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

text.description: The text to scan (up to 8,000 characters). Omit the whole body to scan the published example
